body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> RCA presented its HD quality digital video camcorder 'EZ300HD' at CES 2009.
Adopting a 2.4-inch display, the EZ300HD supports up to 1 hour of video clips in HD mode, or up to 6 hours in YouTube capture mode with a 2GB internal memory.
